worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Set a breathing pace, dim the room, and finish by setting one thing down before the next piece opens.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Read your saved sky as a map, catch comet thoughts, or turn it once around and mint a postcard.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Choose an entry shape, seal a sky record in wax, and finish with one line worth carrying onward.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Pulse your sky into echoes, hear their thoughts one by one, and print the echo weather when it settles.

worlds.name: the pulse choir
worlds.what: Set tempo, mute and reshuffle voices, then finish on a score printed from your sky.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Choose a lighting order, kindle lanterns from your stars, set the wind, and release them to rise.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Grow your sky under glass: water stems, read a forecast, or regrow the whole bed in a new order.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Map your sky as pressure and fronts, probe microclimates, and finish on a forecast from the live field.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Tune symmetry and spin, ripple the weave by touch, and close on a geometry mantra.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Pick a tape, tune one automaton rule, run it, and read what changed at the bit level.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Shove blocks, flip gravity, choose material and bounce, then finish with a damage report.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Set soil grit, plant and water, turn the bed, and finish on a core reading from what grew.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Feed words into heat, pull out coined terms with meanings, and let the batch cool on the shelf.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: Accession impossible specimens, cross-reference the drawer, and file one doubtful truth.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Turn your sky under a wheel, draw an omen, forge a sigil, and stamp the reading into the archive.
